Detailed Description

Interface for HRVS ouput messages consisting of header and payload with unknown size.

If number of received payload items is higher, ReturnCode::HRVS_SDK_ERROR will be thrown.

◆ unpackHeader()

virtual bool hrvs_sdk::IRadarPayloadOutput::unpackHeader ( uint8_t *  buffer,
int  bufferSize 
)
pure virtual

Method composes message header items from series of bytes in buffer, stores them in instance variables and checks message checksum. Method is used to find out how many bytes has payload, so then getMsgLength() returns correct size of message payload.

Parameters
[in]bufferInput buffer where are stored bytes.
[in]bufferSizeFixed size of buffer.
Returns
true Received data are valid (computed checksum and received checksum are equal).
false Received data are not valid (computed checksum and received checksum are not equal).

Implemented in hrvs_sdk::FilteredPointsMsg, and hrvs_sdk::ObjectInfoMsg.
